strongest_verified_result: For normalized real-coefficient holomorphic injections on D, the maximum of |(1-|z|^2)f''(z)/f'(z)-2 conjugate(z)| over the class exists, is less than 4 for each fixed nonreal z, equals 4 on the real diameter, and has a strict uniform gap on every compact subset of D minus R.
excluded_claims: Explicit or sharp quantitative formula for M(z)
General nonreal extremizers and full variability region
Novelty, priority, and current literature status
Unqualified closure of the full original problem
Separate covariance, lower-bound, numerical, and primary-source certification
source_of_historical_wording_resolution: SCOPE_CLARIFICATION.md explicitly replaces quotient with inverse composition.
exact_control_note: An inverse Koebe transform at a=i/2 has A_f(a)=4 but is not a Koebe rotation. Its omitted ray has real endpoint -5/12 and oblique outgoing vector 7/15-8i/5. It is outside the real class, confirming why the endpoint-and-direction symmetry step is essential.
